title: AdaEvolve: Adaptive LLM Driven Zeroth-Order Optimization

mechanism.domainTask: LLM-guided program evolution for mathematical optimization, systems optimization, and algorithm design
mechanism.populationDetail: A dynamic set of asynchronous islands is maintained; each island has a local archive and islands exchange programs by ring migration.
mechanism.archiveDetail: Each island maintains a local archive of programs with elite replacement; diversity is used for exploration and inspiration sampling.
mechanism.replacementDetail: A generated child is added to the island archive and the archive applies elite replacement; migration and dynamic island spawning add higher-level updates; dynamic island spawning, ring migration, UCB island scheduling, and genealogy tracking are important mechanisms beyond the basic population labels.
mechanism.generationDetail: One selected parent program is placed in an Improve-the-following-program prompt; inspirations and optional tactics guide a broad rewrite.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Fitness improvements are converted into local and global adaptive signals, island rewards, and meta-guidance triggers.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: The main parent is local to the selected island; UCB selects the island globally, while inspirations are selected separately.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Hierarchical adaptive controller with UCB resource routing, dynamic island spawning, and meta-level solution tactics is not represented by one existing taxonomy field.
